name: amazonbot
description: Amazon's crawler, which Amazon says improves its products and may train its AI models. Classifies as agent/amazon from the User-Agent alone, at medium confidence, the same treatment as GPTBot. The User-Agent is transcribed verbatim from Amazon's published documentation (https://developer.amazon.com/amazonbot, fetched 2026-09-28), including its `W.X.Y.Z` placeholder for the Chrome version; it is not captured from our own traffic, and the other headers are illustrative. Replace the sample with a real capture the first time one is observed.

headers.user-agent: Mozilla/5.0 AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko; compatible; Amazonbot/0.1) Chrome/W.X.Y.Z Safari/537.36
